thread:
jane_sales: Heads-up — AstraNova just told our AE that they will not move forward with the POC unless we can a) guarantee EU data residency for the trial, b) agree to a latency SLO ~99.95 (p95), and c) cap monthly overage to their budget. They want an exec-level signoff ASAP. POC expected ~200k tokens/day, bursts up to 1M/day for short windows. Can we get SRE/ENG + pricing support? cc @clara_eng @mike_se :exclamation:

mike_se: Thanks — quick q: do they require Private deployment (VPC/on-prem) or is a Hosted EU region with contract controls ok? That changes lead time a lot. Also ask them to confirm model family (1) RLHF chat model vs (2) embeddings-heavy rerank pipeline.

clara_eng: If they're fine with hosted in EU region we can provision a dedicated pool with isolation and tuned batching. Ballpark: for 200k/day steady + bursts, 2 x A100 equivalent nodes should cover 99th latency ~200ms, p50 ~80ms depending on prompt lengths and KV cache hit rate. Need sample prompt distribution to tighten numbers.

jane_sales: They prefer hosted (no on-prem) but insist on contractual data residency + higher SLA. CISO asked for SOC2 attestation + answers to their security questionnaire today. I uploaded their SQ to the drive.

tara_revenue: From pricing side we can build a temporary commercial offer: 20% off list for the POC, with an option to convert to a committed Reserved plan with a steeper discount. To hit the SLA and capacity we need an upfront minimum (we can set a 3-month baseline). Legal will need to review the addendum. What baseline number should we ask them to commit to?

clara_eng: For the dedicated pool approach baseline = 200k tokens/day (~6M tokens/month). If they convert to reserved we can size more efficiently. For immediate unblock we could offer a configured autoscale group with burst credit for 48h windows but that increases cost.

mike_se: Security questionnaire Qs — CISO asked about key management and egress controls. We can offer customer-managed keys (KMS) in EU and IP allowlist for the POC. I can start filling answers but need confirmation on KMS support timeline.

legal_triage_bot: legal-bot: Security questionnaire received and triaged. Priority: HIGH. Assigned to @legal_ops. Requested SLA exception template and EU data residency addendum. ETA initial draft: 48 hours.

dante_product: Practical suggestion — to avoid long provisioning wait we can propose a "hosted-eu plus guardrails" interim: hosted EU region + strict egress rules + KMS + SOC2 attestation + written SLA commitment for the POC window, with a follow-up migration to Dedicated if they sign. That buys time and keeps POC schedule.

clara_eng: Agree with @dante_product. If we do interim hosted config, ops needs a concrete deployment command/manifest. Example quick load test command for them (we'll sanitize tokens):

```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.prod.eu/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-14b","input":"<test prompt>","max_tokens":512}'
```

clara_eng: Also need their sample prompt length distribution and concurrency pattern. If they have many short prompts (<=64 tokens) our batching helps cost/latency. If they stream long outputs we need different kernel tuning.

jane_sales: I'll ask them for a short load sample and the security contacts. I'm going to DM their CISO to accept a temporary Data Processing Addendum for the trial. ETA from me: 2 hours.

tara_revenue: I'll draft a pro-forma POC pricing and a one-page conversion path showing committed reserve options and discounts. Expect initial numbers in ~4 hours.

mike_se: I'll start the security questionnaire answers and confirm KMS support. If legal needs any technical statements (certs, attestation pages), tag me.

ops_bot: deploy-bot: CREATED dedicated-pool-request #DC-7971 (region: eu-west). Provisioning ETA: 72 hours. Temporary hosted-eu guardrail configuration prepared.

jane_sales: Ok looks like path forward: 1) present interim hosted+guardrails + SOC2 + DPA to customer so POC proceeds, 2) legal drafts addendum, 3) ops starts dedicated request as fallback, 4) revenue drafts pricing tie to conversion. Please ping me in thread with any blockers. :thumbsup:

dante_product: Recommend an internal exec touchpoint if legal needs to sign SLA exceptions. If we need signoff beyond legal (e.g., CEO/CPO) tell me and I'll coordinate.

clara_eng: One risk: if prompt distribution is very heavy on long-context generation our latency numbers degrade. Flagging for tracking.

jane_sales: Noted. I'll push for the sample payload now. Thanks all. :pray:
